cases.name: Alice Langer
cases.about: Alice Langer’s family said that she was a retiree who “had a smile for everyone she met” and enjoyed spending time with “her ladies’ group, playing cards, attending concerts, Friday night fish fries and was always up for a good breakfast or lunch date.”
cases.narrative: On 10/26/2022, during a welfare check, she was found shot in the head in the shower with a firearm in her lap at home in what was initially suspected to be a suicide.
